description: Robin Weldy grew up in Lewiston and later built a 24-year career as a business owner and real estate professional. She graduated Magna Cum Laude with a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance and spent her career managing budgets, coordinating construction projects, overseeing teams, and navigating regulatory and local government processes.
